headlines.text: On this day in 2024, Will Ospreay vs. MJF etched their names into history in the first-ever AEW American Title match, appearing on All In: London, rated 8.54 ? a match fans still talk about. Ospreay overcame MJF's attempted brass-knuckles cheat ? foiled by a returning Daniel Garcia ? to hit the Tiger Driver '91 in front of his home London crowd, winning back the International Title.

That Friday in 2023, the AAA Latin American Title made its debut as QT Marshall vs. Gravity battled for the honor of being first champion, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.18. QT Marshall retained his AAA Latin American Championship against Bandido's brother Gravity, closing the show out with a Dirt Sheet Driver despite mocking Gravity's family name beforehand.
On this day in 2021, Jamie Hayter made their long-awaited return to AEW television after just under 2 years away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2024, when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW World Heavyweight Title as Bryan Danielson vs. Swerve Strickland battled it out, appearing on All In: London, rated 9.66 ? the kind of match that redefines a wrestler's career ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. In a Title vs. Career match, Danielson survived Strickland's arsenal of finishers before locking in the LeBell Lock to win the AEW World Championship and save his career in front of 50,000 fans.

It was 2024 when the AEW Women's World Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Mariah May vs. Toni Storm battled it out, appearing on All In: London, rated 8.01 ? a genuinely great match ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. Mariah May was challenging for gold for the very first time. After a nine-month rivalry, May hit Storm's own Storm Zero finisher to dethrone her former mentor and become the new AEW Women's World Champion in an instant classic.

It was 2024 when gold changed shoulders as the AEW World Trios Titles found a new champion as Castagnoli, PAC & Yuta vs. The Patriarchy vs. House of Black vs. Gunns & Robinson battled it out in a Ladder match, appearing on All In: London, rated 7.10 ? a match that delivered ? ending the champion's reign at 1 defense. For Castagnoli, PAC & Yuta, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. It marked House of Black's 10th match with the title on the line. In a four-way London Ladder match, PAC booted Killswitch off Christian Cage's shoulders to grab a title as Blackpool Combat Club dethroned The Patriarchy for the AEW World Trios Championship.
